result.summary: The page mostly renders as a typical food delivery home screen, but there are a few visual/content defects: an implausible '-100%' discount badge, a truncated restaurant name without ellipsis, and a seemingly empty category chip at the edge of the filter row. A few minor cosmetic/accessibility concerns were also noted.

issues.description: The pizza restaurant card shows a '−100%' discount badge, which implies the order would be entirely free. This is almost certainly a data or calculation error.
issues.suggestion: Validate promotion data before rendering; cap or sanity-check discount percentages, or display the intended promo (e.g. 'Free delivery') instead of a raw −100% value.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the third restaurant name is cut off as 'Trattoria Piccol' with no ellipsis, making it look broken rather than intentionally scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Apply text truncation with an ellipsis (e.g. 'Trattoria Piccol…') or ensure the label is fully contained within the visible card area.

issues.description: At the right edge of the category filter row there is a partially visible chip that appears completely empty (no text visible), which looks like a rendering glitch.
issues.suggestion: Ensure all filter chips contain visible label text, or adjust padding/peek amount so partially visible chips still show part of their label to indicate scrollability.

issues.description: The bottom pizza card is abruptly cut off by the tab bar with no visual scroll affordance or fade, making the content boundary look clipped.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding/safe-area inset to the scroll content or a subtle gradient fade above the tab bar so cut-off content reads as scrollable rather than broken.

issues.description: The placeholder text in the search field ('Restaurants, dishes, groceries') uses light gray on a light gray background, giving low contrast.
issues.suggestion: Darken the placeholder text color to meet WCAG AA contrast (at least 4.5:1) against the input background.
